claims.text: Ipratropium nasal 0.03% (rhinorrhea of allergic and nonallergic perennial rhinitis, age 6 and older): two sprays (42 mcg) per nostril two or three times daily.
claims.quote: The recommended dose of ipratropium bromide nasal solution, 0.03% is two sprays (42 mcg) per nostril two or three times daily (total dose 168 to 252 mcg/day) for the symptomatic relief of rhinorrhea associated with allergic and nonallergic perennial rhinitis in adults and children age 6 years and older.

claims.text: CI: hypersensitivity to atropine or its derivatives.
claims.quote: Ipratropium bromide nasal solution, 0.03% is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to atropine or its derivatives

claims.text: Caution: narrow-angle glaucoma, prostatic hyperplasia, bladder-neck obstruction.
claims.quote: should be used with caution in patients with narrow-angle glaucoma, prostatic hyperplasia, or bladder neck obstruction

claims.text: Don't spray in or around the eyes.
claims.quote: Patients should be instructed to avoid spraying ipratropium bromide nasal solution, 0.03% in or around their eyes.
